name: Z-Pattern (Reading)
description: On a page with sparse text and strong graphic elements, readers' eyes are said to move in a Z shape: across the top, diagonally down to the bottom left, then across the bottom, ending at the bottom right.
design_relevance_note: Cited to justify putting the logo top-left, the key message in the diagonal, and the call to action at the bottom right of a landing page.
myth_risk_note: Frequently stated as an established fact about how people read pages, with no study found behind it.
